steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: I've done this 'Wobbly Champagne Flute' ten times, and I didn't throw up!

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: I did the 'Shaking Overalls' twenty times! I didn't throw up, either!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Okay, okay. Hand me all your raffle tickets.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Let's see... ten 'Wobbly Champagne Flute' runs, twenty 'Shaking Overalls' runs. You get three draws.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Alright, let's do the draws now. Goood luuuck.

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: If I win the grand prize, I'm buying that two-story house across the street. That way, I can hit the casinos every day just coming downstairs.

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: Fourth prize isn't so bad either. That's the newest yacht from Box Inc.! I could at least pay off the protection money I owe the Snaptooths.

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: I put my mother's store up as collateral! And I'm still short some money!

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: I don't even care what we end up getting as long as it's not another 'Thanks for playing!'

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: As long as I win something... All this spinning and holding back my urge to barf... will be worth it...

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: There! Let's see what we got!

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: Hold up. I'm still kinda dizzy... Can't see very well...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Whoa! Super! You two are real lucky, you know that?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Felicitaciones! Today's special grand prize! Tickets for 'Another 100 Tries'!

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: Today's special grand prize? 'Another 100 Tries'?! So I get 100 more draws? Awesome!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: No, no, no. That wouldn't be much fun at all...

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: Hah, anyway, these are my tickets!

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: In your dreams! I did all the hard work here!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Okay, okay. Calm down.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: 'Another 100 Tries' means you get to try 'Wobbly Champagne Flute' and 'Shaking Overalls' another hundred times!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: A total of hundred times more for the two of you! That's plenty of fun for everybody!

steps.name: Dizzy & Lightheaded Tourists
steps.text: What?! Bluggh—

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Ugh. Dodged that just in time. Almost got that puke all over me...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Sorry about knocking you out so long, señora receptionist. Here's your uniform, good as new! Now, time for a shift change!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Doesn't look like those two liked the special grand prize, though. Aren't they here to have fun?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: They could've had so much fun for no money at all. What a couple of weirdos...
Hello, there, I'd like a 'Double Sunrise'.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Save it, Pelirrojo. I don't remember coming up with a lame password like that.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Well, actually, I really want to give that drink a try. The guys here with their pockets full of protection money all love it. Is it really that good?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I'm off work, if you know what I mean. Wait till this señora here wakes up, if you want one.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Alright, forget that... I've got some info, seriously. Let's find a place where we can talk.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What's the word? You manage to dig up any dirt on the protection racketeers?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Yeah, I followed a couple of them and found their hideout... Took me longer than I thought.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Turns out the biggest gang in the barrio, the Snaptooths, are behind the protection racket.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: So, if we want to chase them out of the casinos here, we'll make an enemy of the entire gang?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: More precisely, if we want to stay in town, we'll have to follow their rules.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Heh, perfect. I love breaking rules.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Carlie... let's just mind our own business.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: We can keep having fun here, even if they keep collecting protection money, right?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: As long as they aren't taking our money, we don't really have to drive them out.

spans.text: As long as they aren't taking our money, we don't really

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: No, we're doing this.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Look, I told you before.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I came to Dossoles to find a place where I can really be happy.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Yeah, it's fun hitting the casinos, but it bothers me to see these pendejos ruining the fun here.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I can't stand them threatening people, just trying to profit off them.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Yeah, I can't agree more!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: If I were their boss, I wouldn't let my boys do anything like this!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Huh? Really?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Let's go take their bossman down, then!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: I know! Who cares if he's a veteran or working for the mayor? Just gotta beat them till they give up, right?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Ay, why are you always so reckless? Try to use your head for once, alright?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: I've met the guy. I'd even put all the honors I earned in the army on the line. One-on-one, I could take him down easy.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: All thanks to you signing me up for the service, way back when.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: (Murmurs) But if he's actually working for the mayor, even if you took him down, how can you be sure no one's gonna come looking for trouble later?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Never mind... And here I thought you were still mad at me.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: If I didn't trick you into hopping on that army recruiting bus, you probably could've spent a couple more years running those barrios.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Heh, I thought it through, and I don't blame you. If I hadn't gotten on that bus, I probably never would've made it to Dossoles.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: If I hadn't gotten on that bus... I probably would've ended up wasting my whole life away as a slum gang boss.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What's so bad about slums? I wish I was still living there.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: If it wasn't for...
Caper can feel the Originium crystal under her red gloves.
She thought she had gotten used to it, but every now and then, she finds herself unable to ignore it.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Never mind... Not like we have a choice.

steps.name: Arrogant Youth
steps.text: Carajo! Who did that?!

steps.name: Arrogant Youth
steps.text: Hm? Did you kick that can at me, chica?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Yep, that was me.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: You just shook down the old balloon parlor, didn't you?

steps.name: Arrogant Youth
steps.text: How is that any of your business? I—

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Let's not waste time on this guy, Carlie.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Whoa, that's a mean punch.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What are you doing, Pelirrojo?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Why are you going through his pockets?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Why else? I'm taking back all the money he stole from the old man.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Oh, then you gotta give it back to him.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Give it back?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: It's not all from the old man, you know?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Alright, fine. Don't look at me like that. I'll buy a couple balloons from him. That'll work for you?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Let's split up here. I got other business.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Alright, do what you gotta do.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Where did Pelirrojo go...? I haven't seen him all day.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: He did give the money back to the old man, didn't he?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Never mind... Better leave him be.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Carlie...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What are you doing, squatting here? What's with the empty beer cans...? How much have you been drinking?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Hahaha, yeah, I have no idea myself...

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Did you know? Back in the slums... my papa had to shine twenty pairs of shoes before he'd buy himself a can of beer.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What happened to you?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: What happened? Hah, you know what kind of things happen to people in Dossoles...

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Carlie... You saw it, right? I knocked out a street thug with a single punch today.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: The protection money he got... was enough for this much beer...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Pelirrojo...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: That wasn't our money to take.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Heh, I mean, that's true, but... having all the money we could ever spend, isn't that the happiness we're chasing?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Carlie, once we take down the Snaptooth boss, let's take this barrio for ourselves. The two of us!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: We can collect protection, too. We'll have more money than we could ever spend...

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Then, I'll buy my old man a new house, right by the pub! He'll get to drink till he drops!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: You could bring your mamá here, too. We'll run a big factory! Hah, it'll be glorious!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: No, this isn't right...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Where am I...?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I'm home? ... Where's Mamá?

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: I'm here, Carlie.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Phew... Mamá, I really miss you...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: How have you been? Did those bad guys come back again for protection money?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I'm so sorry I never write you...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I've been looking for a place we can really be happy... to live a happy life together...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: A place where no one wants me gone, and no one wrecks your workroom...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: A place where I won't be a burden to you even if I caught Oripathy...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: But I still haven't found that place.

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: It's okay, Carlie.

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: I'll get you treated, even if I have to spend all my savings.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: No, Mamá, don't say that...

steps.name: Mother
steps.text: I just want you to be happy.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Don't say that...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I'd rather you be happy.
The next day...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: That's way too pushy. Where did you learn to write?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Try something like this. Start with, like 'To The Most Honorable Gang Boss,'

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: No... your handwriting's terrible. Do it over!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Alright...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Bueno. Now, add the time and date.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: 'Next Friday, 7 PM, at your hideout.'

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Okay, I know what to put after that.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: 'Be ready. We'll fight, one-on-one.'

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Do it over. Now, at the very end—'Would you perhaps have time for a one-on-one meeting?'

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: I don't get it. We're challenging him to a fight. Do we have to be so polite?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: We're making it sound like we're afraid of him.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: If he actually thinks we're scared of him, that'll make it even more fun.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Alright, whatever you say.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: When the time comes...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: When the time comes, I'll make a little commotion in the casino.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: That'll get all their guys over there, and while their hideout's all empty and undefended, you go find el jefe.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: You're sure you can take him?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: I got my weapon primed and ready for a while now. Heh, I tell you, it's a real treasure.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: When we're done, we'll be the Snaptooths' new bosses, and we'll run the casinos in this town... Maybe, we'll even end up running all Dossoles!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Dream big, huh?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What if this is a trick of mine, again?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Honestly... When I ran into you, I really was thinking about beating a taste of all my army trouble into you.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: But I thought it through. You're a lot smarter than me, and we've known each other a long time... Better make you a friend than an enemy.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: And now I'm sure of it, Carlie. I made the right choice sticking with you.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Hmph. Save it for when this is all over.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Don't mess anything up.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Ugh... Get him started and he just keeps rambling on and on. Did his mamá never teach him to go to bed before ten?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: And he's too confident about our plan. How does he sleep that soundly?

spans.text: And he's too confident about our plan. How does he sleep

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: If we go with the first plan, he'll never become the gang boss.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: No, actually, he probably won't even make it out of the hideout alive.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Never mind... The letter's already sent... If we're gonna make a ruckus, might as well make it a big one.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: It's a perfect opportunity to show everyone in Dossoles what real fun is.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Let's see... The weapon he's bringing with him... Should be around here, right?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Haha, perfecto. This is gonna be so much more fun!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Right, I gotta book us a good spot.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Hola, is this the Sirus Rooftop Restaurant?

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: My tickets! Where are my tickets?!

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: I finished twenty 'Wobbly Champagne Flute' runs for them! Somebody stole my tickets!

steps.name: Frantic Tourist
steps.text: My bag! My bag! What is it doing hanging from the chandelier?!

steps.name: Frenzied Tourist
steps.text: What the... Who poured popcorn butter all over the ground?! These are signed, limited edition sneakers! You people better pay for this!

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Please, everyone, stay calm!

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: There are intruders in the casino. Please stay calm and follow our instructions to evacuate!

steps.name: PA Announcement
steps.text: (Woman's Voice) Ta-da! Buenas tardes, everyone. Please follow the safety instructions and proceed to the entrance plaza. We've prepared a little gift for everybody.

steps.name: PA Announcement
steps.text: (Woman's Voice) Make sure you have your sunglasses, watches, high heels, and all your belongings with you. If you leave anything in—

steps.name: PA Announcement
steps.text: (Man's Voice) Hey! How'd you get in—

steps.name: PA Announcement
steps.text: *whack*

steps.name: PA Announcement
steps.text: (Woman's Voice) Ahem, anyway, enjoy your evening!

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: A gift? I wonder what that's about.

steps.name: Frantic Tourist
steps.text: No idea, but let's go check it out!

steps.name: Frenzied Tourist
steps.text: Hey, are you blind?! Don't step on my shoes!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: C'mon, let's not just stand around. Go out and get yourselves a good spot for the show!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: (Whistles)

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Okay... It's my turn now.

steps.name: Frantic Tourist
steps.text: It's been hours already. Where's our gift?

steps.name: Frenzied Tourist
steps.text: Dammit, where is the staff? Why are they keeping us waiting out here?

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Yes, I followed one of them out here, but it's so crowded, I can't find her now!

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Yeah, yeah... What?

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: There's a situation over at el jefe's?!

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Damnit...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Oh, don't be so impatient. It's almost time.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Yep... Cinco, cuatro, tres, dos, uno. It's showtime!

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: So you're the cabrón who smashed the truck in here?
A truck has bored into the Snaptooth hideout. Its rear is still sticking out of the building.
It's quite an impressive entrance, Pelirrojo thinks to himself.

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Hmph, a broken wall. Now we have even more to worry about than our leaky ceiling, huh?

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: So what do you want? You wrecked my reception room. You better have an explanation for this.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: (What the heck?!)

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: (Didn't we agree on a one-on-one fight? Why are there so many guys here?!)

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: What's this about?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Uh, umm...

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: (Screw it...)
Pelirrojo quietly opens the truck's rear compartment.
On the battlefield, this Originium cannon—which he got from one of his old pals in the military—has blown many enemies to pieces.
There's no doubt it is a formidable weapon.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: One man... or a whole bunch... Makes no difference.
He remembers what Caper told him.

a.text: 'Try not to talk. Keep a mysterious vibe. Then, give them a real surprise.'

steps.text: At the time, he didn't understand why Caper spoke of his formidable weapon like it was a piece of candy.
With the compartment open, he rubs his eyes, thinking he is seeing things.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Coño!
He finally gets it.
The Originium cannon that was supposed to be there is nowhere to be seen. Instead, some colorful cardboard boxes sit quietly in its place.
There are cartoon drawings on the boxes, and the sealing tapes are labeled 'Fun Times'.
He also sees a timer and a lit fuse. What's even worse is that the fuse has only mere centimeters left...
One after another, bursts of fireworks surge to the sky and bloom radiantly.
Some are shaped like flowers, some hearts, and some fowlbeasts... In an instant, the night sky over Dossoles is lit up with different colors.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Hah, what do you think? Beautiful, no?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: It took a lot of work to put together a fireworks show this great!

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: What? That's our gift? And what the heck, it's so loud!

spans.text: our gift? And what the heck, it's so loud!

steps.name: Dizzy Tourist
steps.text: Yeah, way too loud...

steps.name: Frantic Tourist
steps.text: Come on, don't say that. The fireworks are beautiful. It's a shame there are so many buildings here blocking our view, though.

steps.name: Frantic Tourist
steps.text: They really should've given us a heads-up and arranged for a better view.

steps.name: Lightheaded Tourist
steps.text: Ah, whatever. This is lame. Can we go back inside?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I really don't get these Dossoleans.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: All they have to do is look up to enjoy the fireworks... Isn't that good enough?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Back in the slums, every time they had a fireworks show in the city, Mamá and I would watch together... That was a happiness even people like us got to share.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Whatever... They don't get it.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: But... I'm sure Pelirrojo and the guys over there loved the surprise.
A few days later...

steps.name: Security Guard
steps.text: Out of the way! Coming through!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Whoa, what a scene.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: All these cars with flowers and balloons. Even their license plates are in order...
Suddenly, one of the cars leaves the motorcade and stops next to Caper.
The driver door swings open, and a familiar man steps out.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Carlie! There you are. Finally!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Where have you been the last couple days? Didn't even go to the casino, and that's your favorite hangout spot!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Hahaha...

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: What about you? You look pretty busy.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: That's a nice ride you got there.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Uh, it's el jefe's car.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Oh, right. You didn't know. I joined the Snaptooths.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: You see...

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: (Oh... So it's fireworks... They were fireworks!)

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Oh no... I'm done for...

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Are you done?

steps.name: Surprised Girl
steps.text: Ay, dios mío! Cariño, what an amazing fireworks show!

steps.name: Surprised Girl
steps.text: I didn't expect this at all. I thought you were starting another fight... but you had a surprise for me!

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Hm? Oh... Yeah, that's right! I've been planning this for a long time!

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: And you helped me plan the whole thing, didn't you?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Huh? U-Uh, yeah...

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Okay, sweetheart, hurry up and get changed. We're gonna have one hell of a dinner.

steps.name: Surprised Girl
steps.text: Wonderful! Thank you, cariño! I'm looking forward to it!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Um... Do you... still need me for anything else?

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: No, this was more than perfect.

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Guess I had you all wrong.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Uh... No... sorry... I'll figure out a way to pay you back for the wall! I promise!

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Pay me back?

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: You want to pay me back?

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: You took care of a huge problem for me. Why would I want you to pay me anything?

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: I've been worrying about when to propose to my girl, but looks like today's the day!

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Somebody, book me a table at the restaurant with the best view in Dossoles!

steps.name: Snaptooth Gofer
steps.text: Jefe! We got a call from the Sirus Rooftop Restaurant! They want to know if we're showing up for our reservation tonight!

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Huh? We already have a table booked? Your doing again?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Uh, maybe...?

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Impressive, chico. I won't forget this.

steps.name: Snaptooth Boss
steps.text: Quick! Get the car! We're heading over now!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: That night, the girl couldn't stop talking about the fireworks, then... el jefe proposed, and she said yes.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: He was so happy, he inducted me right into the gang.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: The wedding's tonight, and all these cars are heading there.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Oh, well that's a happy ending alright. Guess my plan was a success, huh?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Yeah, it couldn't have gone any better. I didn't expect you to come up with a crazy idea like that.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Hah, honestly, I was real nervous! If you were there, you probably could've heard my sweat hitting the floor!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: But well, now that you're part of them, you can climb the ladder quick. Then, get the punks to stop their protection racket.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Uh... Let's not worry about that for now.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Hurry, get in! I'll take you! You can join the gang too!

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Nah-ah, that sounds kinda lame.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Even if I did join, I'd just make trouble. Nobody's gonna like me there.

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Besides, I'm leaving Dossoles.

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Huh? Why?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Think about it, Carlie. If we both join the gang, we'll get to waltz right into the casinos, and no one would bother us at all!

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Pelirrojo
steps.text: Isn't this the happy place you've been looking for?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: Is it?

steps.name: Caper
steps.text: I don't think I can find the happiness I want here.
Suddenly, the balloons on the bridal cars are all released at once. They slowly take to the sky, floating upwards amid the children's cheers and the crowd's gaze.
By the time Pelirrojo looks back down, Caper is nowhere to be seen.
